description: JSON Schema validator — Validate a JSON document against a JSON Schema (draft-07 / 2019-09 / 2020-12 keywords): type, enum, const, numeric and string limits, pattern, formats (email, date, date-time, uuid, uri, ipv4, ipv6, hostname), arrays (items, prefixItems, contains, uniqueItems), objects (required, properties, patternProperties, additionalProperties, dependentRequired), allOf/anyOf/oneOf/not, if/then/else and local $ref/$defs. Returns valid plus a list of errors with JSON-pointer instance and schema paths. Pass data= and schema= as JSON strings; optional schema_url= to fetch a schema instead. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_json_validate
